description: Embark on a modern adventure with our exclusive 1.5-hour guided e-bike tour of Coronado Island, departing daily. Coronado Bike and Surf is the only tour operator conveniently located at the iconic Hotel del Coronado, offering you a unique and exhilarating way to explore. Our cutting-edge electric bikes amplify your pedaling power, allowing you to effortlessly cover more ground, discover hidden coves, and soak in breathtaking coastal views. This fun and dynamic ride is perfect for anyone looking to experience Coronado's rich history, stunning architecture, and vibrant community in an exciting new way.
what_is_included:
- 1.5-hour guided e-bike tour of Coronado Island

- Premium electric bicycle rental

- Helmet (mandatory for all riders)

- Local, experienced tour guide

- Bottled water

- Tour in English
highlights:
- E-Bike Advantage: Experience the thrill of effortlessly exploring Coronado thanks to the power of our electric bikes.

- Unbeatable Location: We are the only bike tour operator based directly at the Hotel del Coronado, giving you the most convenient start to your adventure.

- Iconic Landmarks & More: See the majestic Hotel del Coronado, the charming Coronado Ferry Landing, historic Spreckels Park, and discover new perspectives.

- Panoramic Views: Take in stunning vistas of the San Diego skyline, Coronado Bridge, and the Pacific Ocean, all while enjoying a comfortable ride.

- Engaging Storytelling: Your expert guide will share fascinating insights into Coronado's history, architecture, and local life.

- Fun for Everyone: An exciting and accessible e-bike adventure suitable for a wide range of ages and fitness levels.
check_in_details: Meet us at our beach shack located directly in front of the Hotel Del Coronado on the bike path.
what_to_bring:
Comfortable clothing suitable for biking (e.g., shorts, t-shirt)

Closed-toe shoes (required for safety)

Sunglasses and sunscreen

Small backpack or fanny pack for personal items

Camera to capture memorable moments
disclaimers:
All participants must sign a waiver of liability prior to the tour.

Helmets are mandatory for all riders.

Participants should be able to comfortably ride an electric bicycle.

Coronado Bike and Surf reserves the right to refuse service to anyone deemed unable to safely participate in the tour.

Tour routes and times may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances, road closures, or weather conditions.

Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are non-refundable. No-shows will not be refunded.

We recommend arriving at least 15 minutes prior to the scheduled tour departure time to ensure a prompt start.
faqs:
Q: Do I need to be an experienced cyclist?
A: No prior experience is necessary! Our e-bikes provide a boost, making the ride enjoyable and accessible for all, even if you haven't biked in years.

Q: Are helmets provided?
A: Yes, helmets are provided and are mandatory for all riders for your safety.

Q: What kind of bikes do you use?
A: We use modern, comfortable electric beach cruiser style bicycles that provide pedal-assist, making every incline feel flat and every ride a breeze.

Q: Is there an age limit?
A: Riders must be at least 10 years old and capable of safely operating an e-bike. Younger children may be accommodated with a tag-along or trailer by prior arrangement and availability; please contact us directly to inquire. All riders under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.

Q: What if it rains?
A: Our tours run rain or shine. In the event of severe weather conditions that make biking unsafe, we will offer a reschedule or a full refund.

Q: Can I bring my own bike?
A: Our tour price includes a high-performance e-bike rental designed for this experience. If you prefer to use your own bike, please contact us directly for pricing adjustments.
